headline: Colombian Merchants Urge Elimination of 40% Tariff on Imported Clothing
summary: The National Federation of Merchants of Colombia (Fenalco) asked the government to eliminate the 40% tariff on imported clothing and establish balanced competitive conditions against international platforms like Temu and Shein.
why: Import tariffs and e-commerce competition directly affect retail pricing structures, margins, and domestic market share for apparel merchants.
